newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close lower on profit-taking.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed lower on profit-taking after several sessions of gains, but brokers expected the market to move up on Monday on the appointment of Abdul Huq Howlader as chairman of Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE).
The DSE index fell 17.89 points or 1.62 percent at 1,083.79 on a turnover of 50 million taka. Gainers led decliners by 88 to 29. Friday is the weekend in Bangladesh.
Howlader was named chairman by the DSE council Sunday after it dismissed Imtiyaz Husain from the post for his involvement in alleged share price manipulation.
Husain was among 36 brokers and company executives implicated by the Securities and Exchange Commission in the price-rigging that roiled the market late last year.
Beximco Pharmaceuticals fell 4.77 taka to 136.76, Bata Shoe lost 3.13 to 138.09 and Chittagong Cement was down 34.46 to 1,699.97.
